title: Warm Argentinian Haggis Skewers
description: A kid-friendly Argentinian dish featuring haggis, stir-fry, and herbal flavors, this recipe is ovo-vegetarian-friendly and perfect for a fun dinner

ingredients.name: haggis
ingredients.notes: traditional Scottish dish made from sheep's heart, liver, and lungs, mixed with onions, oatmeal, and spices

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
Thread the haggis, red bell pepper, onion, and mushrooms onto skewers
Brush the skewers with olive oil and season with salt, black pepper, and garlic
Bake the skewers in the oven for 20 minutes, turning occasionally
While the skewers are baking, fry the eggs in a pan and set aside
Once the skewers are done, serve with fried eggs and garnish with parsley
Stir-fry the skewers with some olive oil and garlic for an extra crispy texture
Serve the Warm Argentinian Haggis Skewers hot and enjoy
